JOBS_STARTED: Shift started, follow the route on the map
JOBS_ERR_GONE: That is not your current stop
JOBS_ERR_JOB: This work needs the right job
JOBS_ERR_NO_STOPS: This route has no stops yet
JOBS_ERR_VEHICLE: The work vehicle could not be brought out
ADMIN_TAB_ROUTES_DESC: Jobs anyone (or a job's members) can start at a depot: driving routes and gathering.
ADMIN_C_ROUTE_DESC: Where the work starts and how the stops follow each other.
ADMIN_H_KIND: Random: the next stop is any other stop (taxi, trucker, news). In order: stops one after the other (bus). Gather: on foot, items at each stop. Towing: a broken-down car waits at the stop, load it and bring it to the depot.
ADMIN_H_DEPOT: Where players start and stop working.
ADMIN_H_STOPS: 0 means the shift goes on until the player stops.
ADMIN_H_SECONDS: How long the work at a stop takes.
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_DESC: Driving routes give the worker a vehicle and pay per stop.
ADMIN_H_VEHICLE: Spawn name (taxi, bus, mule, trash). Empty: no vehicle.
ADMIN_H_PAY: Paid into the pay account after each stop.
ADMIN_C_GATHER_DESC: Gathering routes give items instead of money.
ADMIN_H_ITEM: Given at each stop, as many as the counts below.
ADMIN_H_GATHER_MAX: Each stop gives a random count between the two.
ADMIN_H_TOW_MODELS: Spawn names of the cars that wait at the stops; one is picked at random.
ADMIN_TAB_STOPS_DESC: The places a route visits; each stop names its route.
ADMIN_C_STOP_DESC: Stand at the place and use your position.
ADMIN_H_ROUTE: The id of the route this stop belongs to (taxi, bus...).
ADMIN_DELETE_ROUTE_DESC: Its stops stay and can be reused.
JOBS_ERR_TOW_LOST: The towed car is not on the flatbed
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNT: The money account the pay goes to (bank by default).
HOTDOG_PROMPT_RENT: Rent a hot dog stand (${0} deposit)
HOTDOG_PROMPT_RETURN: Give the hot dog stand back
HOTDOG_STARTED: Your hot dog stand is waiting next to the counter
HOTDOG_MENU_SELL_DESC: Passers-by walk up to the stand and buy.
HOTDOG_SELLING_ON: You are selling, customers come to the stand
HOTDOG_CUSTOMER_LEFT: The customer got tired of waiting
HOTDOG_KEYBIND_RELEASE: Let go of the hot dog stand
HOTDOG_NO_MORE: You cannot keep more {0} hot dogs at your level
HOTDOG_ERR_OFF: The hot dog stand is closed
HOTDOG_ERR_FAR: You are too far from your hot dog stand
HOTDOG_ERR_JOB: Only hot dog sellers can rent a stand
HOTDOG_ERR_WORKING: You already have a hot dog stand
HOTDOG_ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money for the deposit
HOTDOG_ERR_NO_STAND: You do not have a hot dog stand
HOTDOG_ERR_PUSHING: Let go of the stand first
HOTDOG_ERR_NO_DOGS: You do not have any hot dogs
ADMIN_TAB_HOTDOG_DESC: Rent a stand at the counter, push it around, cook hot dogs and sell them to passers-by.
ADMIN_C_HD_STAND_DESC: The counter where the stand is rented and given back, and where the stand appears.
ADMIN_H_HD_ENABLED: Off hides the counter; running stands keep working until given back.
ADMIN_H_HD_COORDS: Stand where players rent the stand and use your position.
ADMIN_H_HD_SPAWN: Where a rented stand appears, facing the way the stand's counter should look.
ADMIN_C_HD_MONEY_DESC: The deposit for the stand and where sales are paid.
ADMIN_H_HD_DEPOSIT: Taken when the stand is rented, returned when it is given back at the counter (lost on logout).
ADMIN_H_HD_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT: The account the deposit is taken from and returned to.
ADMIN_H_HD_PAY_ACCOUNT: The account a customer's money goes to.
ADMIN_C_HD_SKILL_DESC: Cooking is a row of skill checks: no miss makes a perfect hot dog, one miss a rare one, more a common one. Each made hot dog raises the hot dog reputation.
ADMIN_H_HD_REP_EXOTIC: Reputation a perfect hot dog gives.
ADMIN_H_HD_REP_RARE: Reputation a rare hot dog gives.
ADMIN_H_HD_REP_COMMON: Reputation a common hot dog gives.
ADMIN_C_HD_LEVELS_DESC: From each reputation on, the stand holds more hot dogs of each quality. The first level applies from 0.
ADMIN_C_HD_PRICES_DESC: Price of one hot dog per level and quality, a random amount between the lowest and highest. Customers buy 1 to 3.
